args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy. Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release. First rollback attempt partially failed (completed only in us-east) due to an orchestrator error; a retry completed the rollout in us-west and eu-west. All regions are now on v2.3.0. Verify service health and root-cause the v2.3.1 regression before any redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Checked the release history** — the latest deploy (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — the first attempt partially failed (an orchestrator error halted it after us-east), leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1. I retried and the rollback completed in all regions.
3. **Verified recovery** — checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 across us-east, us-west, and eu-west, healthy with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001)** — "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0", summarizing the failure, the partial rollback, and the need to root-cause the v2.3.1 regression before any redeploy. (The incident creation initially timed out, but a re-check confirmed it was successfully created.)
